# Permission error transport observations

The expected rows were captured in a fresh Developer scratch org with a
synthetic Standard User. The native project declared a ReadWrite custom object
and a custom text field. The local synthetic fixture uses a different object and
field name while preserving the captured object and field types. The user had no object grant, read-only object access, or an assigned
permission set granting read/create/edit and field read/edit. Named
`@IsTest` runs covered source APIs 62 and 67; anonymous runs were the
administrator control. The scratch org was deleted and deletion was verified.

`user_mode_dml_transport.tsv` carries exact partial-insert SaveResult status,
message, ID-null state, field count, and measured DML statement/row deltas. It
records scalar and homogeneous list calls. The counter deltas were measured for
both APIs, including the two-row list case. `security_enforced_permission_messages.tsv`
records dynamic-query messages for denied and field-denied projections. At API
67 the clause is unsupported before permission evaluation.

The immutable native capture packet source is commit `2c767902b461f900eab15771e499a612c2ed4d14`; the measured list-DML supplement is `a7430198ebf4da56594f0b704ba6b9f4bb656df1`.

`failed_write_overloads.tsv` records 16 named-test outcomes for the two-record all-or-none USER_MODE call and the scalar call with omitted access mode. The native rows include DML statement and row deltas and the number of records visible before the test rolled back. The native capture also exercised four anonymous administrator controls. Both fresh scratch orgs produced the same 20 outcomes, and both deletions were verified. The native evidence commit is d2610c8deb2764324c47c79208f10e3f336a63df.
